title: Chocolate chip cookies
description: Soft and chewy classic cookies with golden edges and plenty of melted chocolate chips.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, beat the butter with the brown and white sugar until creamy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
Gradually mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto the baking sheet, leaving space between them.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden brown.
Let the cookies cool on the pan for 5 minutes before moving them to a rack.
